rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=40, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1080, seed=42, rationale=FRESH search-20260619-01 iter-1 FEASIBILITY under the corrected protocol (val=ALL 214 L277 slices + 321px detector-geometry FOV; HARD 20-min train+score budget). Hammernik-2017 here is an IMAGE-DOMAIN variational net that denoises the FBP -- NO projector inside the unrolled loop, so each forward is far cheaper than LPD (which ran the PYRO-NN projector in-loop and still did train200+score214 in 1149s/19.2min). That cheapness is spent on CONVERGENCE not capacity, to dodge the LPD trap (under-trained heavy unrolled net -> hr=0 @ SSIM 0.843). Capacity modest: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16 (below the 24 default for a cheaper RBF activation loop), vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31; vn_lambda_init=2.3e-3 = the documented VN-port working corner (LOOSE hint, not validated). Training favors convergence: epochs=40, train_n=200, batch=4, lr=5e-4, grad_clip=1.0; max_train_s=1080 (18min) in-solver wall trips before the 30min SLURM kill, leaving headroom for score(214)+figure. Hyp: a budget-sized, ACTUALLY-CONVERGED Hammernik-2017 lands near or above the ~0.84 LD-FBP-ish SSIM floor within 20 min on Mayo; if even at 40 epochs it stays stuck at hr=0 with lambda_t barely budging (the documented 2026-06-08 failure signature), that is the iter-1 feasibility finding -- a shared-filter-bank structural ceiling, not a config knob away.
